110.long_description:
Tekken 8 is plug and play on any Arcooda game wizard arcade machine by connecting your XBOX Series, Playstation 5 and PC to your machine for Tekken 8 arcade machine game play. Tekken 8 is powered by Unreal Engine 5 and is being released exclusively on PS5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC.

The latest entry in the series introduces an all-new game mechanic called the ”Heat System,” giving players the ability to harness aggressiveness as a tactic and incorporate offensive attacks into their playstyle, with special movements and enhancement of character ability based on each character’s unique features.  

Installation is super easy - purchsase your copy of Tekken 8 from your retailer, install onto your XBOX Series X/S, Playstation 5 or PC, then connect the cables video, audio,controller cables into your Arcooda arcade machine.
